background_story: Jaxson was a colorful parrot known for his mischievous antics and peculiar eating habits. One day, while exploring his owner's workshop, Jaxson discovered a shiny object that caught his eye - a small metal screw. In a split second, he snatched the screw and swallowed it. Panicked, his owner rushed him to the avian vet, fearing the worst. Miraculously, Jaxson's robust digestive system couldn't break down the screw, but it also didn't seem to cause him any harm. The screw became a nondigestible foreign object that remained in his stomach for years, earning him the nickname 'Metal Beak.' Despite this unusual condition, Jaxson continued to thrive, living a long and healthy life, with the screw becoming a permanent, if somewhat bizarre, part of his anatomy.
